_comment: This file intentionally leaves Cors:AllowedOrigins unset. The app fails to start in Production if it's empty (see AddSharedCors) — set it via the Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 (and __1, __2, ...) environment variable(s) on the production host, e.g. Cors__AllowedOrigins__0=https://app.yaraheem.example. Origins must be https:// in Production.
